content: IIoT predictive maintenance systems use layered architectures: 3-tier (edge/fog/cloud), 5C (Connection/Conversion/Cyber/Cognition/Configuration), or microkernel+plugin. Key patterns: dispersed computation at edge for low latency, concentrated computation in cloud for heavy analytics. MQTT and OPC-UA are standard transport protocols. Data flows northbound (sensor→cloud) for analytics, southbound (cloud→edge) for model updates. Modular design allows independent scaling of acquisition, processing, and analytics layers.
